item.summary: fix(mac): profile onboarding updates the operator's host-global managed CLI (#121651) * fix(mac): scope managed CLI install and detection to the active app profile Under an active OPENCLAW_PROFILE the onboarding ready page detected the host-global managed CLI (~/.openclaw/bin/openclaw) and its update/install flow rewrote the operator's real managed copy. The managed install prefix now follows the profile state directory (~/.openclaw-), preferred paths exclude other profiles' managed trees (including stale validated executables and inherited shell PATH entries), and external CLIs stay detectable read-only. Default-profile behavior is unchanged. * chore(mac): refresh native i18n inventory for shifted source lines
